scene.label: Act 3, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. Rome. A Room in Titus's House. A banquet set out
scene.location: Rome. A Room in Titus's House. A banquet set out

content.text: Enter Titus Andronicus, Marcus, Lavinia and the boy Young Lucius.

lines.text: So so; now sit; and look you eat no more
lines.plainText: So so now sit and look you eat no more

lines.text: Than will preserve just so much strength in us
lines.plainText: Than will preserve just so much strength in us

lines.text: As will revenge these bitter woes of ours.
lines.plainText: As will revenge these bitter woes of ours

lines.text: Marcus, unknit that sorrow-wreathen knot.
lines.plainText: Marcus unknit that sorrowwreathen knot

lines.text: Thy niece and I, poor creatures, want our hands,
lines.plainText: Thy niece and I poor creatures want our hands

lines.text: And cannot passionate our tenfold grief
lines.plainText: And cannot passionate our tenfold grief

lines.text: With folded arms. This poor right hand of mine
lines.plainText: With folded arms This poor right hand of mine

lines.text: Is left to tyrannize upon my breast;
lines.plainText: Is left to tyrannize upon my breast

lines.text: Who when my heart, all mad with misery,
lines.plainText: Who when my heart all mad with misery

lines.text: Beats in this hollow prison of my flesh,
lines.plainText: Beats in this hollow prison of my flesh

lines.text: Then thus I thump it down.
lines.plainText: Then thus I thump it down

lines.text: Thou map of woe, that thus dost talk in signs,
lines.plainText: Thou map of woe that thus dost talk in signs

lines.text: When thy poor heart beats with outrageous beating,
lines.plainText: When thy poor heart beats with outrageous beating

lines.text: Thou canst not strike it thus to make it still.
lines.plainText: Thou canst not strike it thus to make it still

lines.text: Wound it with sighing, girl, kill it with groans;
lines.plainText: Wound it with sighing girl kill it with groans

lines.text: Or get some little knife between thy teeth,
lines.plainText: Or get some little knife between thy teeth

lines.text: And just against thy heart make thou a hole,
lines.plainText: And just against thy heart make thou a hole

lines.text: That all the tears that thy poor eyes let fall
lines.plainText: That all the tears that thy poor eyes let fall

lines.text: May run into that sink, and, soaking in,
lines.plainText: May run into that sink and soaking in

lines.text: Drown the lamenting fool in sea-salt tears.
lines.plainText: Drown the lamenting fool in seasalt tears

lines.text: Fie, brother, fie! Teach her not thus to lay
lines.plainText: Fie brother fie Teach her not thus to lay

lines.text: Such violent hands upon her tender life.
lines.plainText: Such violent hands upon her tender life

lines.text: How now! Has sorrow made thee dote already?
lines.plainText: How now Has sorrow made thee dote already

lines.text: Why, Marcus, no man should be mad but I.
lines.plainText: Why Marcus no man should be mad but I

lines.text: What violent hands can she lay on her life?
lines.plainText: What violent hands can she lay on her life

lines.text: Ah, wherefore dost thou urge the name of hands,
lines.plainText: Ah wherefore dost thou urge the name of hands

lines.text: To bid Æneas tell the tale twice o'er
lines.plainText: To bid neas tell the tale twice o'er

lines.text: How Troy was burnt and he made miserable?
lines.plainText: How Troy was burnt and he made miserable

lines.text: O, handle not the theme, to talk of hands,
lines.plainText: O handle not the theme to talk of hands

lines.text: Lest we remember still that we have none.
lines.plainText: Lest we remember still that we have none

lines.text: Fie, fie, how frantically I square my talk,
lines.plainText: Fie fie how frantically I square my talk

lines.text: As if we should forget we had no hands,
lines.plainText: As if we should forget we had no hands

lines.text: If Marcus did not name the word of hands!
lines.plainText: If Marcus did not name the word of hands

lines.text: Come, let's fall to; and, gentle girl, eat this.
lines.plainText: Come let's fall to and gentle girl eat this

lines.text: Here is no drink! Hark, Marcus, what she says;
lines.plainText: Here is no drink Hark Marcus what she says

lines.text: I can interpret all her martyred signs.
lines.plainText: I can interpret all her martyred signs

lines.text: She says she drinks no other drink but tears,
lines.plainText: She says she drinks no other drink but tears

lines.text: Brewed with her sorrow, meshed upon her cheeks.
lines.plainText: Brewed with her sorrow meshed upon her cheeks

lines.text: Speechless complainer, I will learn thy thought;
lines.plainText: Speechless complainer I will learn thy thought

lines.text: In thy dumb action will I be as perfect
lines.plainText: In thy dumb action will I be as perfect

lines.text: As begging hermits in their holy prayers.
lines.plainText: As begging hermits in their holy prayers

lines.text: Thou shalt not sigh, nor hold thy stumps to heaven,
lines.plainText: Thou shalt not sigh nor hold thy stumps to heaven

lines.text: Nor wink, nor nod, nor kneel, nor make a sign,
lines.plainText: Nor wink nor nod nor kneel nor make a sign

lines.text: But I of these will wrest an alphabet,
lines.plainText: But I of these will wrest an alphabet

lines.text: And by still practice learn to know thy meaning.
lines.plainText: And by still practice learn to know thy meaning

lines.text: Good grandsire, leave these bitter deep laments.
lines.plainText: Good grandsire leave these bitter deep laments

lines.text: Make my aunt merry with some pleasing tale.
lines.plainText: Make my aunt merry with some pleasing tale

lines.text: Alas, the tender boy, in passion moved,
lines.plainText: Alas the tender boy in passion moved

lines.text: Doth weep to see his grandsire's heaviness.
lines.plainText: Doth weep to see his grandsire's heaviness

lines.text: Peace, tender sapling; thou art made of tears,
lines.plainText: Peace tender sapling thou art made of tears

lines.text: And tears will quickly melt thy life away.
lines.plainText: And tears will quickly melt thy life away

content.text: [Marcus strikes the dish with a knife.]

lines.text: At that that I have killed, my lord, a fly.
lines.plainText: At that that I have killed my lord a fly

lines.text: Out on thee, murderer! Thou kill'st my heart;
lines.plainText: Out on thee murderer Thou kill'st my heart

lines.text: Mine eyes are cloyed with view of tyranny;
lines.plainText: Mine eyes are cloyed with view of tyranny

lines.text: A deed of death done on the innocent
lines.plainText: A deed of death done on the innocent

lines.text: Becomes not Titus' brother. Get thee gone;
lines.plainText: Becomes not Titus' brother Get thee gone

lines.text: I see thou art not for my company.
lines.plainText: I see thou art not for my company

lines.text: Alas, my lord, I have but killed a fly.
lines.plainText: Alas my lord I have but killed a fly

lines.text: "But"? How if that fly had a father and mother?
lines.plainText: But How if that fly had a father and mother

lines.text: How would he hang his slender gilded wings
lines.plainText: How would he hang his slender gilded wings

lines.text: And buzz lamenting doings in the air!
lines.plainText: And buzz lamenting doings in the air

lines.text: Poor harmless fly,
lines.plainText: Poor harmless fly

lines.text: That with his pretty buzzing melody,
lines.plainText: That with his pretty buzzing melody

lines.text: Came here to make us merry, and thou hast killed him.
lines.plainText: Came here to make us merry and thou hast killed him

lines.text: Pardon me, sir; 'twas a black ill-favoured fly,
lines.plainText: Pardon me sir 'twas a black illfavoured fly

lines.text: Like to the empress' Moor; therefore I killed him.
lines.plainText: Like to the empress' Moor therefore I killed him

lines.text: O, O, O!
lines.plainText: O O O

lines.text: Then pardon me for reprehending thee,
lines.plainText: Then pardon me for reprehending thee

lines.text: For thou hast done a charitable deed.
lines.plainText: For thou hast done a charitable deed

lines.text: Give me thy knife, I will insult on him,
lines.plainText: Give me thy knife I will insult on him

lines.text: Flattering myself as if it were the Moor
lines.plainText: Flattering myself as if it were the Moor

lines.text: Come hither purposely to poison me.
lines.plainText: Come hither purposely to poison me

lines.text: There's for thyself, and that's for Tamora.
lines.plainText: There's for thyself and that's for Tamora

lines.text: Ah, sirrah!
lines.plainText: Ah sirrah

lines.text: Yet, I think, we are not brought so low
lines.plainText: Yet I think we are not brought so low

lines.text: But that between us we can kill a fly
lines.plainText: But that between us we can kill a fly

lines.text: That comes in likeness of a coal-black Moor.
lines.plainText: That comes in likeness of a coalblack Moor

lines.text: Alas, poor man, grief has so wrought on him,
lines.plainText: Alas poor man grief has so wrought on him

lines.text: He takes false shadows for true substances.
lines.plainText: He takes false shadows for true substances

lines.text: Come, take away. Lavinia, go with me.
lines.plainText: Come take away Lavinia go with me

lines.text: I'll to thy closet, and go read with thee
lines.plainText: I'll to thy closet and go read with thee

lines.text: Sad stories chanced in the times of old.
lines.plainText: Sad stories chanced in the times of old

lines.text: Come, boy, and go with me. Thy sight is young,
lines.plainText: Come boy and go with me Thy sight is young

lines.text: And thou shalt read when mine begin to dazzle.
lines.plainText: And thou shalt read when mine begin to dazzle
